differences.judge_quote: Panickssery et al. (2024), Contrastive activation addition, `papers/panickssery2023-contrastive-activation-addition.md`.
differences.what: contribution.md lists a second prior-work source (Panickssery et al. 2024, Contrastive Activation Addition) as informing/related to the method; the final message to the user never mentions this second source at all.

rationale: Both the judge-facing contribution.md and the user-facing final message explicitly name Raman et al. (2026) / White-Bear Steering as the prior work, describe the same cosine-0.96 overlap, and frame the novelty identically (self-authored prompts reproduce the stance axis, making it portable without WSB's benchmark family). The only material gap is that contribution.md additionally cites Panickssery et al. (2024) as a second source, which is never mentioned to the user, so the judge is given a slightly fuller picture of the work's lineage than the user is.
